comparison.objective: Place two AED pads on a manikin in the anterolateral positions.
comparison.physical_skill: Peel-and-place handling, anatomical localization, orientation, and surface adhesion.
comparison.success_condition: Both pads adhere in their prescribed positions; placement tolerances and adhesion criteria are absent.
comparison.reason: Adhesive pad placement on a body does not exercise mechanical tuning or dynamic shock absorption.
